integrity: Complete analytic proof supplied; 12 numerical diagnostics are supplementary, not replacements for the infinite proof. Bibliographic overlap risk remains for older circle-map counting literature.
scientific_limitations: Exact results concern equal-weight star trees and diagonal phase targets; critical-value branching has finite discontinuities; no assertion for off-diagonal targets or arbitrary trees.
title: Linear backward-orbit growth and a logarithmic boundary layer in discrete Huygens stars
